entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I... I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed this didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88912. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I was really looking forward to this jersey.

I see the order right here for the ClubFit Jersey. I can appreciate your disappointment. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's just the wrong size. I waited a bit too long to try it on, and it's just way too tight across the chest. I was hoping to exchange it, but honestly, with money being so tight right now, I just really need the refund.
I understand. Let me check the purchase date for you. Okay, I see the delivery was about 81 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Oh, has it been that long? I feel terrible. I just really, really needed this money back for the holidays. I hope it's not too late.
Not a problem at all. I've just checked, and you're well within our 90-day return window for the jersey. I can absolutely process a full refund for you today. There's no issue here.
Really? Oh, thank you! That is such a huge relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much, David, you have no idea what a help that is.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack the item up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. I'll get that sent out this afternoon. Thank you again for your help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been wonderful.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
